_comment: The harness kinds a harness placement may name in NOO_HARNESS_KIND, declared ONCE. The gateway (gateway-rust/src/harness_kinds.rs) validates placements against it, the node agent embeds a byte-equal copy (node-agent-go/internal/reconcile/harness_kinds.json, held equal by TestHarnessKindsTableMatchesTheShippedFile) for wire compatibility, runner and vendor-CLI presence, lane and telemetry switches, and the noo CLI checks --kind against it. kind: the NOO_HARNESS_KIND value. wire: the API the harness speaks. wires: the node chat backend types that serve it (empty = no node backend serves it yet). runner: the executable the applier installs beside the agent; ONE runner serves every kind, the gateway binary in harness mode (`noo-gateway harness`), which for a foreign kind launches the vendor's headless CLI and fronts the node's model with a loopback wire translator (null = no runner ships yet; the node agent refuses the kind). cli: the vendor executable that must be on PATH on the node for a foreign kind (null for `noo`); the node agent refuses the kind while it is absent. lane: env vars the runner sets to keep the CLI one-shot and inside its lane (no auto-update, no interactive prompt, no vendor login flow), merged after any placement value; only variables verified in vendor documentation are listed, empty when none are. launch: how the driver invokes the CLI (null for `noo`): command is the argv with {prompt} filled in, model_url_env and model_env name the variables that point the CLI at the loopback translator and name its model, mcp says how the CLI takes an MCP server. A value starting `unverified:` is documented-but-unconfirmed or undocumented and is for the driver (i83 phase E1c) to settle. telemetry_off: the vendor telemetry switches the runner must launch it with, merged after any placement value (docs/security/telemetry.md, Agent harnesses); every kind has an entry, empty when there is nothing to switch off or none is declared yet.

launch.model_url_env: unverified:no env var documented; config.toml [model_providers.<name>] base_url
